description: This Java class defines constants related to external service configurations, such as S3, SMTP, SMS, and notification services. It includes enums for JSON input parameters specific to each service, providing types and utility methods.

classes.name: ExternalServicesConstants
classes.description: Final class housing constants and enums for external service configuration parameters, including service names and JSON input parameter types.

methods.name: ExternalServicesConstants()
methods.description: Private constructor to prevent instantiation of utility class.

methods.name: getAllValues
methods.description: Static method in each enum to get the set of all string values defined for the enum.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides to return a human-readable string of enum constant name.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the string value associated with each enum constant.
